snippet.title: Capitalism Lab Lets Play and bit of a guide  - Part 1
snippet.description:
Decided there isn't enough Let's Plays for this game. I've tried to explain what I'm doing as I play to turn it into a bit of a guide as well.

If of any interested I could try and do short guides for different sections and/or for the basics.
